items.title: As-Needed Landscape Architectural Services No. 3 – Merrill Morris Partners, Inc. – Contract Award
items.text: As-Needed Landscape Architectural Services No. 3 – Merrill Morris Partners, Inc. – Contract Award Staff Recommendation: Award Professional Services Contract, As-Needed Landscape Architectural Services No. 3 in the amount of $800,000 for 1,825 calendar days to Merrill Morris Partners, Inc. for landscape architectural services. Approve an increase of $400,000 contingency to the total contract not-to-exceed amount. Also authorize the Director of Public Works to approve future contract modifications, increasing the total not-to-exceed amount to $1,200,000.
items.parent: Consent Calendar of Routine Matters Regular Items for Consideration
